body: The hand axe and empty sack are bound with torn tape reading "evacuation checkpoint - restricted access." A paper tag hangs from the knot, showing one location struck through and another written over it in different ink. The tape's edges preserve fragments of printed postings about moving people and keeping records.
title: Hand axe and sack, the cold night

body: The deer came from a pasture that had been sprayed yesterday. Its mouth was wet with a bitter smell, and its legs shook. The driver said the creek near the rows smelled the same.
title: Grass along the shoulder
